# elemento_compute (Data Source)

Looks up an existing Elemento virtual machine on the cloud selected by `host`. There is no Get-by-id for compute; the provider lists running VMs and matches exactly one of `uuid`, `billing_uuid`, or `vm_name`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `billing_uuid` (String) Portal billing UUID of the VM.
- `region` (String) Optional region filter, also populated from the API.
- `uuid` (String) VM uniqueID. Exactly one of uuid, billing_uuid, or vm_name must be set.
- `vm_name` (String) VM name. Not unique; use uuid when more than one match exists.

### Read-Only

- `allow_smt` (Boolean) Whether SMT is allowed.
- `arch` (List of String) CPU architecture.
- `cpu_slots` (Number) Allocated CPU slots.
- `flags` (List of String) CPU flags.
- `ipv4` (String) Primary IPv4 address when present.
- `max_overprovision` (Number) CPU overprovision factor.
- `os_family` (String) OS family.
- `os_flavour` (String) OS flavour.
- `ram_size_mb` (Number) Memory capacity in MB (API ramsize in GB multiplied by 1024).
- `require_ecc` (Boolean) Whether ECC memory is required.
- `status` (String) Portal billing status, when billing_uuid is available.
- `tags` (String) Colon-separated VM tags.
- `volumes` (Attributes List) Volumes attached to the VM. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--volumes))

<a id="nestedatt--volumes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `volumes`

Read-Only:

- `bootable` (Boolean) Whether the volume is bootable.
- `name` (String) Volume name.
- `private` (Boolean) Whether the volume is private.
- `readonly` (Boolean) Whether the volume is read-only.
- `region` (String) Volume region.
- `shareable` (Boolean) Whether the volume is shareable.
- `size` (Number) Volume size as returned by the API.
- `volume_uuid` (String) Volume UUID.
